senses.gloss: ש׳ רד (v. שָׁלַח) illegitimate use of a deposit, misappropriation.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 43b:3">B. Mets. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ יד אינה צריכה חסרון</he> use of a deposit does not require damage (in order to make the depositary responsible for losses for which he could otherwise not be made responsible).

senses.gloss: message, agency, commission. Ib. 41ᵃ ש׳ מנלן whence do we derive the law of agency (in betrothal)? Ib. 42ᵃ קטנים לאו בני ש׳ וכ׳ minors cannot serve as deputies.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Meilah 6:1">Meïl. VI, 1</cite>, a. e. <he>השליח שעשה שְׁלִיחוּתוֹ וכ׳</he> if the agent has carried out his commission (exactly as he was told), the owner is guilty of misappropriation (v. <cite ref="M02125"><he>מָעַל</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Meilah 20b:30">Ib. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>מוסיף על שליחותו</he> if the agent adds an act of his own to that for which he was commissioned.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:1">Lev. R. s. 22</cite> <he>אם אין … שְׁלִיחוּתִי וכ׳</he> if you (prophets) do not convey my message, I have (other) messengers.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50:2">Gen. R. s. 50</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 18:2">Gen. XVIII, 2</cite>, a.

<cite ref="Genesis 19:1">XIX, 1</cite>) <he>עד שלא עשו שְׁלִיחוּתָן קראן וכ׳</he> before they carried out their message, the text calls them men, when they did carry it out, it calls them messengers (angels); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="U01310"><he>שְׁלִיחוֹת</he></cite> (fr. <cite ref="U01309"><he>שְׁלִיחָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Genesis 19:1">Ib.</cite>; Yalk. ib. 84; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 908:9-16">Yalk. Job 908</cite> <he>אין … שתי ש׳</he> one angel never carries two messages.
